name: plantree
description: Plan, review, edit, and copy task-tree execution prompts into Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review task trees in the Codex sidebar.
interface.longDescription: PlanTree turns a goal into an editable task tree and copies the approved execution chain as a Markdown file for any Codex conversation.
